facts.text: The Singular Patagonia was built on the site of the former Frigorifico Bories, which was declared a National Monument in 1996.
facts.excerpt: The Singular Patagonia se construyó donde funcionaba el Frigorífico Bories, declarado Monumento Nacional en 1996.

facts.text: In the transition areas of the hotel-museum, the old machinery remains intact and visible.
facts.excerpt: Y en las áreas de transición de este hotel-museo, la maquinaria de antaño está intactamente visible.

facts.text: The hotel offers guests a guided tour of the history of the former cold-storage plant.
facts.excerpt: Ofrecemos un tour guidado para huépedes, donde podrán sumergirse en la historia que dio origen en 1915 a la Sociedad Explotadora Tierra del Fuego

facts.text: The hotel's museum is open to the public and covers the history of Puerto Bories and the old cold-storage plant that gave rise to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: El Museo de The Singular Patagonia está abierto a todo público y permite conocer parte de la historia de Puerto Bories y del antiguo frigorífico que dio origen al hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is in Chilean Patagonia, five minutes from Puerto Natales, on the Senoret Channel.
facts.excerpt: El hotel está ubicado en la Patagonia chilena, a 5 minutos de Puerto Natales y en el canal de Señoret

facts.text: Excursions can start from the hotel to remote places including Torres del Paine National Park.
facts.excerpt: lugar desde donde se pueden iniciar excursiones a los lugares más remotos del planeta, incluyendo el Parque Nacional Torres del Paine

facts.text: The restaurant menu uses Patagonian ingredients such as guanaco, king crab, rhubarb and austral hake, in a setting overlooking the austral fjords.
facts.excerpt: Our menu highlights dishes constructed using a bounty of Patagonia-sourced ingredients such a guanaco, king crab, rhubarb or austral hake, prepared with classic techniques in a rustic and elegant setting overlooking the breathtaking austral fjords.

facts.text: The Singular Restaurant's cuisine is by Executive Chef Hernan Basso, fusing French trends with locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: award-winning cuisine from our Executive Chef, Hernán Basso, fusing French trends with locally sourced ingredients

facts.text: Breakfast is served overlooking the Senoret Channel.
facts.excerpt: to receive the first meal of the day overlooking the breathtaking Señoret Channel

facts.text: The bar is a favorite spot for guests after a full day of excursions.
facts.excerpt: It's the favorite spot for our guests to enjoy after a full day of excursions.

facts.text: Room service is currently unavailable.
facts.excerpt: Room service is currently unavailable.

facts.text: El Asador, in the property's 100-year-old former blacksmith's forge, is listed as opening soon.
facts.excerpt: in a historic and rustic atmosphere of the property's 100-year-old former blacksmith's forge

facts.text: A funicular takes guests down from the brick reception area to the main building.
facts.excerpt: The exposed pipes in brick reception area and the funicular that take you down to the main building feel steampunk without the whimsy.

facts.text: The main structures were built as a sheep-processing plant in 1915.
facts.excerpt: The main structures were built as a sheep-processing plant in 1915

facts.text: Rooms feature a wall-sized window looking out onto Ultima Esperanza Sound, and all rooms have the same view.
facts.excerpt: with the main feature being a wall-sized window looking out onto Ultima Esperanza Sound

facts.text: The pool is indoor/outdoor, letting guests swim under a giant window looking out onto the Sound and out into the open air.
facts.excerpt: The pool is indoor/outdoor—you can swim under a giant window looking out onto the Sound and be outside in the wind.

facts.text: The spa's sauna has a view of the Sound.
facts.excerpt: The spa is also very lovely, and the sauna has the same spectacular view.

facts.text: Excursions offered include a 12-hour trek to the base of the Paine Massif, kayaking on the Sound and a cooking class with the executive chef.
facts.excerpt: a 12 hour trek to the base of the Paine Massif or kayaking on the Sound or a cooking class with the executive chef

facts.text: The hotel sits alone on the waterfront with a dock dating back to the sheep-processing days.
facts.excerpt: The hotel sits in grand isolation, all alone on the waterfront with a dock dating back to the sheep-processing days.

facts.text: The hotel provides bikes that guests can ride into Puerto Natales.
facts.excerpt: You can easily ride a bike (provided by the hotel) into Puerto Natales

facts.text: Breakfast is included with the basic rate, with half-board and full-board options also available.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast (a very nice buffet) is included with the basic rate, and there are also half-board and full-board options with more meals included.

facts.text: The Singular Patagonia was on Conde Nast Traveler's Gold List 2020.
facts.excerpt: Gold List 2020
